name: 64052 · Independence, MO
findings: ZIP 64052 (Independence) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64052 (Independence) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64052 (Independence) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
